digest.component_or_area: LLM framework structured output and caching
propositions: Live structured-output canary over Anthropic (anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6) with byte-identical 41k-char system prefix executed two calls (write/read) producing identical cache_write_tokens=10697 and cache_read_tokens=10697 with requests=1 each and no retry consumed.

Live structured-output canary over Bedrock (bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6) executed the same two-call sequence with cache_write_tokens=10685 and cache_read_tokens=10685 symmetrically, requests=1 each, confirming prompt caching is operative on both providers.

Complete-vs-omit branch instrumentation on seam-1 wire projection observed directly: both providers' both calls took COMPLETE branch (1 message in, 1 kept, 0 omitted), OMIT branch unexercised as expected for well-formed first response.

Observed accounting (requests, input_tokens, cache read/write tokens, retry allowance) matches docs/llm-framework.md §structured retry layers contract on every count the happy path exercises; mixed-provider fallback chain cache collapse (0/0) noted as undocumented but not a canary divergence.

No credentials printed, logged, or persisted; only model ids and integer counts recorded; Anthropic arm authenticated via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable, Bedrock arm via ambient AWS credential chain (profile frontier, region us-west-2).
